metadata.task: Deliver the blood sample container without tilting or dropping it.

plan.goal: Navigate to the Blood Bank, pick up a blood sample container, and deliver it to the Pharmacy without tilting or dropping it.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Blood Bank zone to locate the blood sample container.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Main Entrance.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Blood Bank zone.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot needs to move from the Main Entrance to the Blood Bank. The skill 'navigate_to_room' maps to the Nav2 'navigate_to_pose' action, which is supported by the robot's capabilities (can_navigate, supports_indoor_navigation).

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Locate the blood sample container within the Blood Bank.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Blood Bank zone.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has detected the blood sample container.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must detect the blood sample container to proceed with picking it up. The skill 'detect_object' uses the robot's visual perception capabilities (has_visual_perception, can_detect_objects) and publishes detections via the ROS2 topic.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Estimate the precise 3D pose of the blood sample container.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot has detected the blood sample container.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has the estimated pose of the blood sample container.

grounded_skills.reason: To pick up the object without tilting or dropping it, the robot needs an accurate 3D pose estimate. The skill 'estimate_object_pose' uses depth perception and object detection to provide this pose.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the pose of the blood sample container.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot has the estimated pose of the blood sample container.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is positioned at the blood sample container.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must move to the location of the blood sample container to perform the pick action. This skill grounds the navigation to the object's pose.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Grasp the blood sample container securely.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is positioned at the blood sample container.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the blood sample container.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot needs to grasp the object. The skill 'pick_object' uses MoveIt2 to plan and execute a grasp trajectory. The robot has the necessary capabilities (can_pick, can_grasp, can_manipulate).

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Pharmacy with the blood sample container.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the blood sample container at the Blood Bank.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Pharmacy zone.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must transport the object to the Pharmacy. While carrying, the robot navigates to the destination room. The skill 'navigate_to_room' is used for the transport phase.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the blood sample container on a stable surface in the Pharmacy.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Pharmacy holding the blood sample container.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has placed the blood sample container in the Pharmacy.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must release the object at the destination. The skill 'place_object' uses MoveIt2 to move the end-effector to a stable pose on a surface and release the gripper.

constraints: The robot must maintain a stable grip during transport to prevent tilting or dropping.
The robot must navigate carefully to avoid collisions with obstacles in the corridors.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The robot successfully navigates to the Blood Bank, detects and picks up the blood sample container, transports it to the Pharmacy, and places it safely without tilting or dropping.
